basis: The row-based rule assigning trials 1–21 to imagery and 22–42 to video was explicitly identified as invalid in the event-grammar audit.
Context was reconstructed from EEG annotation/event grammar rather than behavioral row number.
A context-specific trial index was recomputed in acquisition order and mapped through the dataset README sequence.
Held-out semantic specifications prohibit canonical stimulus/category targets and reconstruct them from authoritative context plus context-specific sequence position.
27 split-level parent tests are present and none pass multiplicity-adjusted significance.
